greeting: Hi y'all, thanks for stopping by! Feel free to call me Brandon.
paragraphs: I studied at the University of Nevada, Las Vegas and earned a **Bachelor of Science in Computer Science**. Since then, I've been fortunate to learn from talented teams across industry and academia.

At Credit One Bank, I interned as a **Full-Stack Developer Intern**, building React applications and API endpoints that supported an effort to modernize the company's mobile experience. At UNLV's Department of Geoscience, I worked as a **Student Web Developer**, focusing on building accessible, standards-compliant webpages and improving support for users of assistive technologies.
I later joined Raytheon as a **Software Engineer**, collaborating with an incredible team and growing my skills through hands-on engineering work.
Currently, I am **Software Engineer at Huntington Ingalls Industries**, converted from a prior contract at Insight Global, where I'm building performant, user-friendly web applications.
I love solving hard problems, learning quickly, and shipping polished, accessible experiences.
